recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the FHIR-14821 invariant unless Patient Care makes a new decision to change current entered-in-error Condition semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-14821 was a Published Patient Care STU3 Condition issue. It asked whether Condition.clinicalStatus cardinality could be changed to 1..1 because clinical and verification status were treated as mandatory; the Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead asked to add an invariant prohibiting clinicalStatus when verificationStatus is entered-in-error.
initial_application: Commit b88fc91916dd76f6587b8f326b9ea447d69381cd applied FHIR-14821 by adding the Condition invariant row 'No clinicalStatus when entered in error' to source/condition/condition-spreadsheet.xml and attaching it to clinicalStatus and verificationStatus. Later generated/source history carried that invariant forward until subsequent R5 work.
additional_context: FHIR-28458, a later Published Patient Care issue, removed Condition con-5 while clarifying refuted Condition guidance. FHIR-29409 then required Condition.clinicalStatus 1..1, removed the prior con-3 dependency on problem-list-item category, loosened Condition.category binding, and added the current comment explaining that clinicalStatus is required because it is a modifier element. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes Condition in the build.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml has clinicalStatus min=1, verificationStatus min=0, current later constraints, and no entered-in-error clinicalStatus prohibition, which is correct after the later published decisions.
